study_actions.title: Atlas study exercise: Classify a data workload
study_actions.detail: Compare an order-entry system with a sales-reporting workload. Describe their transaction and analytical needs, choose a suitable data model for each, and identify which Azure data service categories warrant further study. Explain the decision without treating product names as interchangeable. This is a study aid, not an official exam question or a prediction of your result.
